```yaml
name: Check for old group references

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  check-old-group:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Find references to old group
        id: find
        run: |
          echo "Searching for references to kibana/cloud-security-posture in changed files..."
          # Get list of changed files between the base and head of the PR
          changed_files=$(git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.before }} ${{ github.sha }})
          echo "Changed files: $changed_files"
          found=false
          for file in $changed_files; do
            if grep -q "kibana/cloud-security-posture" "$file"; then
              echo "Found reference in $file"
              found=true
            fi
          done
          echo "found=$found" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Comment on PR if references found
        if: steps.find.outputs.found == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const { owner, repo } = context.repo;
            const prNumber = context.issue.number;
            const commentBody = `
⚠️ **Deprecated group reference detected**

The pull request contains references to the old GitHub group **kibana/cloud-security-posture**. Please update them to the new group name **kibana/contextual-security**.

If you need assistance, refer to the migration guide or reach out to the security team.`;
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner,
              repo,
              issue_number: prNumber,
              body: commentBody
            });
```
